hook_text: You could fit the USA, China and India inside it, all at once. What is it?
clip_script: Durban beachfront. Warm waves from the Indian Ocean. A globe turns to show a giant continent across the middle of the Earth: Africa. The equator crosses it, so it is in both hemispheres. Second biggest after Asia, more than fifty countries. Europe is just across the Mediterranean, Asia across the Red Sea. Atlantic Ocean on the west, cold. Indian Ocean on the east, warm. And Africa ends at the tip, where the two oceans meet.
visual_style: Whiteboard globe turning to Africa, then a map of Africa with arrows labelling each ocean and sea around it.
mood: Proud and amazed, like meeting a giant who turns out to be family.
pacing: Slow turn of the globe, then quick labels for oceans and seas.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and label the oceans and seas around Africa yourself.
